name: 会話の共有資料と保存項目の件数
prompt:
Revise the previous candidate to match the two-row WhatsApp contact-info card. Keep its exact Japanese copy, typography scale, icon positions, status counts and chevrons, but correct the outer surface. Output an isolated 390x132 component: uniform light-gray page background #F2F2F2; one pure-white rounded card at x16 y22, width358, height88, radius16. The card has no border stroke, no outline, and no shadow. Its edge is visible only because white card meets light-gray page background. Leave clear light-gray outside margins. Draw exactly one thin gray divider between the two rows, from about x68 to x374; do not add a line at the card's bottom.

First row centered near y44: black outlined photo icon (about 20x18 at x26), dark regular Meiryo label 「写真・リンク・資料」 at x68, gray regular count 「3件」 near the right, and a small light-gray chevron at the far right. Second row centered near y88: black outlined star, dark regular Meiryo label 「保存したメッセージ」, gray regular count 「なし」, and small light-gray chevron. Keep text at #1D1D1D and counts at #6E6E6E. Keep icon strokes black/dark, not gray. These are navigation rows, not hyperlink text; the word リンク is part of the category name. Do not color any label blue. The user requires blue for real hyperlinks, and there are none in this component.

Preserve the source screenshot's compact two-row geometry and restrained iOS appearance. Do not add a card border, extra separators, header, avatar, status bar, additional rows or text. Do not enlarge the icons or make the row labels bold. Keep the canvas clean and crisp.
reviewNotes: The border stroke is removed; the white rounded card, gray page, one divider, exact Japanese labels and values, black icons, gray counts and chevrons now align closely with the original screenshot crop. Residuals against the native preview remain: first row is about 11px lower at 390px width, and native preview has a lower divider that the original screenshot does not. The flat background/card also retain slight generated tonal texture. Two attempts used; keep needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
